About Us
 LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.
Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
Role profile
The Post Trade Division in LSEG has launched a Data Transformation program called Concorde. The objective is to have a new, centralised, and secure way to manage Post Trade data on cloud native technology in AWS and Snowflake. The operating model is a federated model with Core Engineering teams based in London/Bucharest and Engineers based in each Business division to lead the implementation of tenancies on AWS, Azure and Snowflake.
 About The Team
 The Concorde Platform Team is responsible for managing a secure, scalable, and highly available cloud platform built on AWS, Azure, and Snowflake. Our mission is to deliver a strategic Common Data and Reporting solution for clients, members, and regulators by consolidating multiple data sources into a centralised reporting data store.
 What We Do
 By creating a unified data platform, we aim to:
Unlock data-driven business value and enhance analytics capabilities
Democratize and monetize data across the organization
Enable holistic cross-business insights into clients and members
Empower self-service analytics for stakeholders
This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge cloud technologies and contribute to building a platform that transforms how data is leveraged across the business.
 Key Responsibilities
As a Senior Data Engineer for the Concorde Platform Team, you will oversee Snowflake platform health, performance, and overall reliability, including troubleshooting ingestion, transformation, and orchestration issues.
You will provide support to platform tenants on Snowflake and Apache Airflow, ensuring smooth operations across data pipelines.
Develop and maintain an end‑to‑end testing framework to safeguard tenant flows during platform changes, while continuously optimizing queries and storage for performance and cost efficiency.
Automate operational tasks through GitLab CI/CD pipelines and contribute to a consistent, well-managed release process.
Document data architecture, pipeline processes, and best practices, and collaborate with the Snowflake team to evaluate and adopt new tools and frameworks.
Actively support the release process to ensure consistent, high‑quality platform delivery.
 Required Skills:
Design and development of automated data pipelines and data structures
5+ years of working with Python Programming
3+ years hands on data engineering experience for data warehouse solutions using Snowflake, SQL or similar
Experience using Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration
Hands on experience with building CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or similar tools.
Experience working with Agile Delivery teams (Scrum, Kanban) and JIRA
Ability to build automated testing to test data pipelines
Up-to-date knowledge of technology standards, industry trends, emerging technologies and software development best practices 
 Optional/Nice-to-have Skills:
Experience with managing infrastructure using terraform
Experience with using dbt for data transformation and modelling
Experience with kafka event streaming and messaging
